in_sanskrit.name: Sushen
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Himalayas
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sushen एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sushen refers to the lord of the Himalayas, a symbol of strength, wisdom, and grace. In Hindu mythology, Sushen is considered the god of fertility, rain, and the harvest. He is often depicted as a tall, powerful figure with multiple arms, holding a conch shell, a discus, and a mace.
